roomSizes.label: Single-Rack Equipment Room
roomSizes.avImplication: Localized AV/IT distribution room serving a nearby floor, zone, or cluster of spaces.

roomSizes.label: Multi-Rack Equipment Room
roomSizes.avImplication: Central AV/IT support room serving multiple spaces, floors, or venues with higher infrastructure density.

roomSizes.label: Huddle
roomSizes.avImplication: Compact enclosed collaboration room with a single front-of-room display and simple camera/mic coverage.

roomSizes.label: Small
roomSizes.avImplication: Small collaboration room with straightforward display, audio, and camera coverage requirements.

roomSizes.label: Medium
roomSizes.avImplication: Balanced room size where improved sightlines, audio pickup, and one or two displays begin to matter consistently.

roomSizes.label: Large
roomSizes.avImplication: Larger room envelope where wider camera coverage, dual displays, DSP audio, or expanded microphone strategy are common.

roomSizes.label: X-Large
roomSizes.avImplication: Largest standard room scale where multi-camera coverage, distributed audio, and integrated control are commonly required.

roomSizes.label: Kiosk Single Display
roomSizes.avImplication: Standalone kiosk endpoint for wayfinding, corporate messaging, or self-service workflows.

variants.avImplication: Small-format single display for general communications, dashboards, or branding.
Mid-scale single display for high-visibility messaging and common-area communications.
Large-format single display for more prominent messaging, dashboards, or feature areas.
Flagship single display for high-visibility communications in prominent spaces.
Small-format video wall for branded messaging, feature areas, or high-impact dashboards.
Mid-scale video wall for synchronized content, data visualization, or feature communications.
Large-format video wall for signature messaging, branded environments, or major public areas.

roomSizes.label: Small Operations Center
roomSizes.baseline: Compact operations floor / single operator row
roomSizes.avImplication: Shared monitoring room with front visualization, operator consoles, and compact supervisory or support positioning.

roomSizes.label: Medium Operations Center
roomSizes.baseline: Dedicated operations floor / one to two operator rows
roomSizes.avImplication: Operational room with a larger video wall, multiple operator stations, and greater switching, control, and communications density.

roomSizes.label: Large Operations Center
roomSizes.avImplication: Large operations environment with expanded video wall area, supervisor positions, and higher redundancy and infrastructure demands.

roomSizes.label: Small Venue
roomSizes.avImplication: Single-room venue where distributed audio, large-format display/projection, broader camera coverage, and preset-based operation are common.

roomSizes.label: Large Venue
roomSizes.avImplication: High-capacity environment where operator workflows, zoning, staging, or broadcast-style support are more likely.

Basic.title: Basic Configuration
Basic.summary: A user-driven collaboration space with minimal installed technology.
Basic.description: A user-driven space with minimal installed technology. It typically includes a single display with wired or wireless BYOD connectivity for local presentation. It may include USB-connected camera, microphone, and speaker capability for basic conferencing, but does not include a dedicated room codec or touch panel. Users operate meetings from their personal device.
characteristics: BYOD-driven meeting operation
Single display for local content sharing
Optional USB camera, microphone, or speaker
No dedicated room codec
No touch panel room control
Lowest integration and operational complexity
Basic.commercialPositioning: Appropriate where low cost, simple deployment, and user-led operation are more important than a standardised appliance-based meeting experience.

Standard.title: Standard Configuration
Standard.summary: A fully integrated conferencing space built around a dedicated collaboration platform.
Standard.description: A fully integrated conferencing space built around a dedicated platform codec such as Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or Webex. It includes a fixed camera, microphones, and speakers connected directly to the room system, with touch panel control for one-touch join, call management, and volume adjustment. It is designed for consistent, reliable hybrid meetings without requiring user setup.
characteristics: Dedicated Teams, Zoom, or Webex room system
Fixed camera, microphones, and speakers
Touch panel for one-touch join and call control
Consistent hybrid meeting experience
Reduced user setup and operational friction
Suitable for repeatable standard room deployments
Standard.commercialPositioning: Appropriate for mainstream collaboration spaces where consistency, usability, and supportability are the primary drivers.

Advanced.title: Advanced Configuration
Advanced.summary: A high-performance collaboration space with deeper AV integration and enhanced automation.
Advanced.description: A high-performance collaboration space featuring a fully integrated AV system with advanced audio and video capabilities. It may include DSP-based audio processing, ceiling or array microphones, camera tracking or framing, centralised room control, and environmental integration. It supports more complex hybrid meetings, larger groups, and optimised coverage across the room.
characteristics: Fully integrated AV system
DSP-based audio processing
Ceiling, array, or expanded microphone coverage
Camera tracking, framing, or multi-camera support
Room control and preset-based operation
May include environmental controls such as lighting or shades
Advanced.commercialPositioning: Appropriate where room performance, coverage, automation, and integration depth justify a higher design and deployment investment.

Expert.title: Expert Configuration
Expert.summary: A professional-grade environment for large-scale, specialist, executive, or mission-critical use cases.
Expert.description: A professional-grade environment built for large-scale or specialised applications such as auditoriums, studios, executive spaces, operations centres, or mission-critical collaboration. It incorporates advanced AV infrastructure, multiple camera systems, high-output audio, environmental integration, and may require an AV operator or trained technician to support live events, broadcasts, or critical collaboration workflows.
characteristics: Professional-grade AV infrastructure
Multiple camera systems or intelligent camera workflows
High-output or distributed audio systems
Advanced control, automation, and environmental integration
May require AV operator or trained technician support
Suitable for live events, broadcasts, executive, specialist, or mission-critical spaces
Expert.commercialPositioning: Appropriate where reliability, production quality, specialist workflows, resilience, and operational assurance are key value drivers.

Divisible.title: Divisible Configuration
Divisible.summary: A reconfigurable space designed to operate as independent zones or one combined environment.
Divisible.description: A divisible configuration supports a space that can operate as separate rooms or as one combined area. Each section typically has its own display, microphones, speakers, and control logic. When combined, the system links audio and video workflows for unified operation. Room-combine behaviour may be managed through wall sensors, user presets, or programmed control logic.
characteristics: Independent room zones with dedicated AV capability
Combined mode for unified space operation
Room-combine audio and video logic
Preset or sensor-driven configuration changes
Higher control programming and commissioning requirement
Often priced or scoped per divisible zone or space
Divisible.commercialPositioning: Appropriate for flexible multipurpose spaces where utilisation, reconfiguration speed, and operational flexibility justify additional control and integration complexity.
